note: Authoritative support matrix for littrace. README.md, README.zh-CN.md and SECURITY.md link here for the authoritative values and do not maintain a separate matrix; if a summary elsewhere disagrees, this file wins. Update this file in the same commit as any change to those claims. status values: primary = developed and verified on this platform; supported = exercised end to end, version details below; unverified = expected to run but not verified; unsupported = no build and no promise.

python.note: CI is configured for CPython 3.10 and 3.13 on Ubuntu and 3.13 on Windows; the nightly workflow adds 3.14 on Ubuntu. No CI result is published while the repository is private, so these are configured targets rather than published results. At the time of writing, a local run of `python -m pytest -m "not network and not model"` on CPython 3.13.11 passed 455 tests, and `ruff check .` passed with both the pinned ruff 0.16.4 and the installed ruff 0.16.10. The number of passing tests changes as tests are added; do not treat a count as a promise. Python 3.11 and 3.12 appear in package classifiers but are not in the CI matrix.

platforms.label: Windows x64
platforms.note: Primary development and verification platform. CI runs the Python suite on windows-latest with Python 3.13 and the frontend tests on windows-latest. API keys are protected with DPAPI, which is Windows-only.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.note: No installer, no CI leg and no maintainer verification. DPAPI secret storage is not available; a different secret-storage adapter would be required.

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.note: CI is configured for ubuntu-24.04 with Python 3.10 and 3.13 plus the frontend tests, but no CI result is published while the repository is private. No maintainer verification. DPAPI secret storage is not available; a different secret-storage adapter would be required.

zotero.channel: Local Zotero SQLite database, read-only snapshot
zotero.note: littrace reads zotero.sqlite, item metadata, collections, attachments, notes and annotations through a read-only SQLite snapshot, and never writes to Zotero. The local schema differs across Zotero releases. Read-only access has been exercised against a working local library, but the exact Zotero release was not recorded; no specific version is pinned yet. A release will be listed in tested_versions only after an end-to-end sync against a real library. The future Zotero plugin will get its own plugin x Zotero version matrix.

plugin.note: The Zotero plugin (plugin/, XPI) runs inside Zotero and loads the local service pages in function tabs. Verification on 2026-11-19 used Zotero 10.0.8 (x64 en-US) on Windows with an isolated profile and a read-only snapshot of a real library (412 items); see docs/plugin-verification.md for the per-item record and what remains unverified. status stays "unverified" until every M0 gate item and the M1 UI checklist have been signed off by the maintainer: tab rendering, version negotiation and the item-pane sections passed, while the lineage column, the reader panel, deep links, concurrent writes and schema migration are not yet verified. tested_versions lists only releases that were actually exercised. strict_max_version uses the x.x.* form so a compatibility bump can ship through updates.json without republishing the XPI.

ollama.note: Defaults come from kbapp/core/config.py (EMBED_MODEL, GLM_OCR_MODEL and the local_text_model setting). The local verifier can be changed in settings. Changing a model invalidates caches keyed by model identity. Ollama itself has no pinned version yet. OCR can be redirected with GLM_OCR_URL, GLM_OCR_MODEL and GLM_OCR_API. CI is offline and does not exercise Ollama. No model combination has been recorded as verified, so the names above are defaults, not a tested combination.

cloud.note: Cloud verification is off by default and is configured in the settings page with an endpoint and key. The reference setup was exercised with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; other OpenAI-compatible endpoints are not verified. Cited answers and method-relation verification require a configured cloud endpoint; ingest, indexing, search and offline export do not. Connectivity can be checked before enabling it: POST /api/settings/test issues one GET {api_base}/models against the saved configuration, at zero token cost and with a 5 s budget (below the plugin's 10 s request timeout). The probe proves reachability and that credentials were accepted; it does not prove the configured model can infer, and endpoints without /models report as unsupported rather than OK.

out_of_scope: builds modified by the user, including patched dependencies or a forked kbapp
scanner-only reports without a reproduction on a clean checkout
local model or proxy configuration errors
problems in Zotero itself, or in a library that littrace only reads
